description.value:
Traits Signal

An ally in range whose current Hit Points are below half their maximum may spend Encore even if the round's shared spend has already been used, and their spend does not use it up for anyone else. The spend is otherwise unchanged: 1 Encore, a reroll of one failed check, no action cost, a fortune effect. Each such ally may do this at most once per round.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (no pool) and SB2 (the spend is a reroll grant). No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either. No Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in Foundry's pf2e system (confirmed: zero hits for "key": "Reroll" in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/, and the full 34-entry rule-element key list has no reroll key -- RollTwice is a different, pre-result advantage/disadvantage mechanic). Encore's core primitive, "spend 1 Encore to reroll a failed check," is a post-result reroll and is categorically unbuildable as a standing rule element.
